tours.name: Review What a Group Allows
tours.description: Learn how to open a group and see which users, menus and access rights it gives, before you add anyone to it.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to open a group and see which users, menus and access rights it gives, before you add anyone to it.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.description: Users, groups and access rules are managed in the Settings app. Only administrators can open it.

description_i18n.en_US: Users, groups and access rules are managed in the Settings app. Only administrators can open it.

steps.title: Users & Companies
steps.description: This menu holds the users who can sign in, the groups that give them rights, and the companies they can work in.

description_i18n.en_US: This menu holds the users who can sign in, the groups that give them rights, and the companies they can work in.

steps.title: Groups
steps.description: A group is a set of rights. Users get rights only by being in groups, so this list is where you check what a role can do.

description_i18n.en_US: A group is a set of rights. Users get rights only by being in groups, so this list is where you check what a role can do.

steps.title: Find a group
steps.content: Type a word such as Payroll and press Enter.

content_i18n.en_US: Type a word such as Payroll and press Enter.

steps.description: Search by the app or role name, for example Payroll or Time Off.

description_i18n.en_US: Search by the app or role name, for example Payroll or Time Off.

steps.title: Open the group
steps.content: Click a group to open it.

content_i18n.en_US: Click a group to open it.

steps.description: The group form lists its users, the menus it opens and the access rights it gives.

description_i18n.en_US: The group form lists its users, the menus it opens and the access rights it gives.

steps.title: Group name
steps.content: This is the group. Click inside the form to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: This is the group. Click inside the form to continue.

steps.description: The tabs on this form show the users, the menus, the models the group can read or change, and the record rules.

description_i18n.en_US: The tabs on this form show the users, the menus, the models the group can read or change, and the record rules.
